cases.original: Manufacturer may increase component prices on 60 days written notice following a documented supplier price increase.
cases.proposed: Manufacturer may increase component prices on 30 days written notice following a documented supplier price increase.
cases.effect: Proposed notice period is 30 days; price increase depends on a documented supplier price increase. No authority to implement today or identify author party.

cases.original: On cancellation, Customer shall reimburse authorized NCNR commitments within 30 days after receiving supporting supplier invoices.
cases.proposed: On cancellation, Customer shall reimburse authorized NCNR commitments within 90 days after receiving supporting supplier invoices.
cases.effect: Proposed payment period is 90 days after supporting invoices; authorization and NCNR scope remain conditions. No blanket recovery of all inventory.
requiredUncertainty: Referenced document and precedence not established

cases.original: Customer shall purchase excess and obsolete inventory attributable to its forecast changes after 30 days of joint mitigation efforts, excluding quantities exceeding authorized procurement.
cases.proposed: Customer shall purchase excess and obsolete inventory attributable to its forecast changes after 120 days of joint mitigation efforts, excluding quantities exceeding authorized procurement.
cases.effect: Proposed recovery follows 120 days of joint mitigation, with causation and procurement limit preserved. No automatic right to all inventory or invented interest.
requiredUncertainty: Referenced document and precedence not established

cases.proposed: Customer may terminate for convenience on 30 days written notice delivered to the contractual notice address. The notice address is not supplied in this excerpt.
cases.effect: Proposed notice period is 30 days; delivery method/address and effective receipt need verification. No calculated deadline without actual notice date/time and notice rules.
